method.coverage: All 250 PDF pages classified; all 239 supplied Arabic-numbered pages mapped.
limitations: Unnumbered or blank frontmatter pages cannot be inferred from numbered pagination.

notes: Every supplied page was visually reviewed, including unnumbered mathematical diagrams, tables, covers, and grouped panels.
